page_title: WOL 1-3 LEV | Wolfsburg v Bayer Leverkusen 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Mark Flekken makes a simple save.

90+4' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
90+3' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayer Leverkusen.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ernest Poku trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
84' Daniel Bauer prepares a substitution. Sael Kumbedi is replaced by Jan Burger (Wolfsburg).

83' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) latches onto a short pass from Christian Eriksen inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
83' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

83' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Wolfsburg.

82' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) hits a long-range volley without any hesitation towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows good anticipation and makes a save. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.

82' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
81' Wolfsburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
76' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
75' Kasper Hjulmand decides to make a substitution. Alejandro Grimaldo will be replaced by Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen).
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Patrik Schick walks off the pitch to be replaced by Christian Michel Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen).
74' The attendance for today's match is 20000.
73' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Mark Flekken makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
72' 6:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

67' Close! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
66' The sound of the whistle has almost been drowned out in the deafening atmosphere of this match. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is setting the ball up for a free kick from mid-range.
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) for Malik Tillman.
64' After what seems an eternity, referee Robert Hartmann decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Wolfsburg, play to continue.
64' The Wolfsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Hartmann makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
62' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) has a great chance inside the box and fires the ball inside the left post.
61' Substitution. Dzenan Pejcinovic will be replaced by Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg).
61' Daniel Bauer has decided to make a change. Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) replaces Patrick Wimmer.
61' A substitution has been made. Yannick Gerhardt goes off and Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) comes on.
60' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) does well to meet a cross from Jonas Hofmann, but he directs his shot just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.

57' 1 - 3 Denis Vavro (Wolfsburg) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the resulting corner and scores with a great header into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:3.
57' Corner kick. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
57' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Wolfsburg earn a corner.

55' CLOSE! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
53' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
50' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
48' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

47' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) takes a long-range shot, but his attempt is not a big threat to the goalkeeper. Mark Flekken pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the bottom left corner, but was stopped by the goalkeeper. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
47' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) whips the ball into the box and Lovro Majer takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
46' Half-time substitution. Jenson Seelt is replaced by Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg).
46' Half-time substitution. Kasper Hjulmand decided to make a change. Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) is replaced by Jarell Quansah.
46' Referee Robert Hartmann blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sends the corner into the box, but Mark Flekken intercepts it and averts the threat.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolfsburg.
45' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.

44' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
40' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes.

37' Bayer Leverkusen hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
34' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
33' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Patrik Schick laid the ball off to Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.

32' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
32' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg). The referee points to the corner flag and Wolfsburg will take a corner.
31' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
30' 2:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
27' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle as Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

24' 0 - 2 Goal! Aleix Garcia swings the ball deep into the box and finds Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
24' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
24' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
23' Bayer Leverkusen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

21' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
19' The possession of the ball – 32:68.
17' A dangerous looking corner kick from Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is cleared to safety by the defence.
16' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Wolfsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
15' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

14' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. The ball is out of play. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
14' A pass by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
13' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

9' 0 - 1 Goal! Alejandro Grimaldo displays great vision and sends a pass to Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
8' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
7' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
3' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
